contract.purpose: War Chest helps a strategy-game lover grow an enduring warband through an authored story, tactical battles and spatial equipment choices.
contract.purposeSource: PRODUCT.md and STORY.md; owner story-mode request. Canonical catalog remains the local tactical-game experiment.
contract.canonicalPurpose: Explore a playable tactical war game with a persistent company and spatial equipment choices.
contract.audience: Sarthak, and potential paying strategy players as a quality bar; native desktop single-player, no commerce authorization.
contract.job: Understand whom the company protects, make a practical story decision, prepare a loadout, and play the next encounter through to its consequences.
contract.thesis: Make responsibility personal: a company recovering ordinary households' winter wages, with people visible before rewards.
contract.system: Three distinct native composition/interaction systems will retain the approved adult flat Banner & Steel art and semantic olive/stone/paper/ink colors. Typography, dialogue hierarchy, road composition and preparation transitions are compared using the same real scene.
contract.signature: Named households in a stolen war chest connect the people at Lantern Gate, the spatial chest the player packs, and the final return of the wages.
contract.risk: Dialogue can become a decorative reskin or bury decisions. Keep speech short, expose actual consequences, tie missions to rescue/escort/recovery, and test complete earned routes.
contract.qualityBar: Owner doubts a buyer would be happy and requests story mode. The scene must establish named immediate stakes, readable character voices, consequential choices, a finite campaign road and coherent preparation. No interface score or solver completion is evidence of attachment or commercial satisfaction.

hierarchy.observation: Named speaker, human stakes and one clear next action across actual opening, choice, preparation, reward, defeat and ending. Exact cart costs appear before activation; future route entries remain secondary.

typography.observation: Serif speech/titles and native sans controls/task text remain readable at actual content lengths. Full Ivo and evacuation lines fit. Deduction: compact secondary metadata and limited weight range; increased text sizes unverified.

composition.observation: Selected world/company/speech/decision system continues into actual three-chapter road and spatial chest. Final caption/button overlap and duplicate raw-error strip are corrected. Deduction: repeated armed poses and reused gate background.

identity.observation: Rowan, Lysa/Ivo, winter wages, Lantern Gate, three fronts and the spatial rune chest tie the system to War Chest. Approved adult flat Banner & Steel is preserved.

interaction.observation: 90 actual Main callback checks cover dialogue, exact guide return, focus handoffs, preparation, retry, banner claim/equipment, invalid choice feedback, real decoy convoy, journal and ending/free-play. Root manually earned Gate and Rune-Cleave Ashen. Full late manual routes unverified.

responsive.observation: 18 actual-Main native fixtures at 1440x900 and 1152x720. Final required-size states preserve speech/actions/costs without clipping. New-surface wide/tall resize and increased text sizes unverified; 390/768 unsupported.
